evidence_boundary: Offline matrix and contract coverage only. This file does not prove runtime Android or macOS acceptance and cannot close the README Phase 1 actionable-errors gate without retained device evidence for every supported state.

states.system_state: USB client reaches a peer route, but the Mac app closes before display configuration or the Protocol v1 upgrade probe closes before a response.
states.source_classifier: ConnectionGuidanceFactory.hostNotRunning from pre-display rejection or closed protocol probe
states.ui_surface: USB inline connection guidance panel
states.user_visible_copy: connection_guidance_mac_unavailable_title plus connection_guidance_usb_open_mac_prefix and the active ADB recovery resource
states.user_action: Open Vibe Screen on the Mac, keep the chosen USB debugging transport authorized, use the Mac app's USB repair action if needed, then retry.

states.system_state: USB mode has no usable Android-to-Mac route or ADB reverse mapping, including ECONNREFUSED or other refused transport details.
states.source_classifier: ConnectionGuidanceFactory.usbRouteUnavailable or networkUnreachable with USB context; retryable transport, heartbeat, and write failures may be reclassified from refused or route-unreachable details
states.ui_surface: USB inline connection guidance panel
states.user_visible_copy: connection_guidance_adb_route_unavailable_title plus connection_guidance_usb_route_unavailable_prefix and the active ADB recovery resource
states.user_action: Reconnect or authorize the Android device, use the Mac app's USB repair action, then retry.

contract.title: ADB reverse route missing
contract.body: USB mode cannot reach the Mac because the Android-to-Mac reverse route for TCP 54321 is missing, refused, or stale.
contract.action: Reconnect or authorize the Android device, use the Mac app USB repair action to restore the reverse route, then retry.

states.system_state: USB mode loses the authorized phone connection or has no usable USB transport before the client can reach the Mac route.
states.source_classifier: ConnectionGuidanceFactory.networkUnreachable or usbRouteUnavailable with USB context; Host setup diagnostics for missing authorized devices remain a separate Host-side row
states.ui_surface: USB inline connection guidance panel
states.user_visible_copy: connection_guidance_adb_route_unavailable_title plus connection_guidance_usb_route_unavailable_prefix and the active USB recovery resource
states.user_action: Reconnect the USB cable, unlock and authorize the Android device, wait for the Mac app to repair the route, then retry.

contract.title: USB device disconnected
contract.body: The Android device is no longer reachable over the authorized USB debugging transport, so the client cannot use the local stream route.
contract.action: Reconnect the cable, unlock and authorize the phone, wait for the Mac app to repair USB routing, then retry.

states.system_state: Trusted LAN cannot route to the saved Mac address or DNS name.
states.source_classifier: ConnectionGuidanceFactory.networkUnreachable with LAN context
states.ui_surface: Wireless repair surface
states.user_visible_copy: connection_guidance_network_unavailable_title plus connection_guidance_lan_network_unavailable_message
states.user_action: Reconnect both devices to the same trusted Wi-Fi, disable VPN or guest isolation, verify the saved Mac address and port, then reconnect.

contract.title: LAN route unavailable
contract.body: Trusted LAN cannot route from the Android device to the saved Mac address and port on the same private network.
contract.action: Reconnect both devices to the same trusted Wi-Fi, disable VPN or guest isolation, verify the saved Mac address and port, then reconnect.

states.system_state: Protocol v1 media, audio, file-transfer, clipboard, or action data belongs to an older session/config epoch and must be rejected or dropped instead of mutating the active session.
states.source_classifier: RendererOwner, StreamMediaFrameRouter, ProtocolV1Session, file-transfer, audio, clipboard, and action dispatch stale-epoch guards
states.ui_surface: Protocol diagnostics and reconnect guidance when stale epochs repeat or become terminal
states.user_visible_copy: Fresh-session guidance: reconnect the current session and update both peers if stale epoch rejection repeats.
states.user_action: Reconnect to force a fresh session epoch; if the stale-epoch error repeats, update Vibe Screen on both devices and collect logs before claiming device recovery.

contract.title: Stale session epoch
contract.body: The client rejected data from an older Protocol v1 session or configuration epoch to protect the current stream state.
contract.action: Reconnect for a fresh session epoch; if it repeats, update both devices and collect logs instead of treating recovery as device-verified.

states.system_state: USB, LAN, or Internet connect attempt times out.
states.source_classifier: ConnectionGuidanceFactory.timeout from SocketTimeoutException or timeout detail; retryable heartbeat failures are detail-classified and may route elsewhere when the detail is refused or unreachable
states.ui_surface: Mode-specific terminal guidance surface
states.user_visible_copy: connection_guidance_timeout_title with USB, LAN, or Internet timeout recovery resource
states.user_action: Confirm the Host is listening on the selected route, check the network or ADB tunnel, and retry with a fresh profile when required.

states.system_state: LAN or Internet QR scan cannot continue because Camera permission is denied or permanently denied.
states.source_classifier: Camera permission request and Settings-return state machine
states.ui_surface: QR scanner permission panel with Open Settings action
states.user_visible_copy: camera_permission_required, camera_permission_settings_instructions, and internet_camera_permission_blocked
states.user_action: Open Android Settings, allow Camera for Vibe Screen, return to the app, and retry the QR scan.

states.system_state: Peer sends incompatible protocol, unknown message, rejected session, invalid display, invalid envelope, invalid frame, invalid media header, or invalid media payload.
states.source_classifier: ConnectionGuidanceFactory maps terminal protocol SessionFailureKind values to INCOMPATIBLE_SESSION
states.ui_surface: Mode-specific terminal guidance surface
states.user_visible_copy: connection_guidance_mac_incompatible_title and connection_guidance_mac_incompatible_message
states.user_action: Update Vibe Screen on both devices, then reconnect. The raw peer detail is intentionally not shown in user copy.

states.system_state: Outbound input writer reaches true capacity saturation or rejects a non-retryable input failure.
states.source_classifier: SessionFailureKind.OUTBOUND_BACKPRESSURE
states.ui_surface: Mode-specific terminal guidance surface
states.user_visible_copy: connection_guidance_input_overloaded_title and connection_guidance_input_overloaded_message
states.user_action: Reconnect, then reduce simultaneous touch or peripheral input.

states.system_state: MediaCodec decoder cannot apply the advertised video configuration or recover a compatible stream.
states.source_classifier: SessionFailureKind.CODEC_CONFIGURATION
states.ui_surface: Mode-specific terminal guidance surface
states.user_visible_copy: connection_guidance_video_decoder_recovery_title and connection_guidance_video_decoder_recovery_message
states.user_action: Keep the Mac app open while the client retries with a compatible codec; if it repeats, gather logs and switch to a known supported codec path before claiming acceptance.

states.system_state: Internet mode loses its WebRTC peer connection, ICE candidate pair, data channel, or direct/relay route after a product session starts.
states.source_classifier: InternetProductSession and WebRtcInternetTransport disconnect/recovery callbacks, including route loss, ICE failure, data-channel close, and active TURN allocation disconnects
states.ui_surface: Internet connection recovery surface and route-status diagnostics
states.user_visible_copy: Internet connection lost or reconnecting guidance with Direct/TURN route status and a fresh-session retry action
states.user_action: Keep the Mac app online, verify the Internet profile is still valid, switch networks or allow the app through VPN/firewall restrictions, then retry with a fresh Direct or TURN route.

states.system_state: Host and Android client cannot agree on a common locally encodable and decodable video codec before streaming begins.
states.source_classifier: Protocol v1 Internet product codec rejects unsupported codec sets, including no-common-codec and unsupported AV1 admission paths
states.ui_surface: Mode-specific terminal guidance surface
states.user_visible_copy: connection_guidance_mac_incompatible_title or video decoder recovery copy with a codec-specific diagnostic reason
states.user_action: Update Vibe Screen on both devices or select a supported H.264/HEVC path; do not keep retrying the same incompatible codec set.

states.system_state: A managed configuration from either peer denies a negotiated feature or host route, so deny wins even when local UI controls are available.
states.source_classifier: ManagedPolicyStatus merge and restriction-result validation for clipboard, file transfer, audio, wake, host actions, allowed hosts, and denied hosts
states.ui_surface: Feature-specific disabled or denied feedback plus Host/Android managed-policy diagnostics
states.user_visible_copy: Managed policy disabled this action, with the denied restriction and source shown in diagnostics rather than raw protocol text
states.user_action: Use an allowed host or action, or ask the device/workspace administrator to change the managed policy before retrying.

states.system_state: A negotiated generic peripheral-input envelope names a concrete peripheral kind that the current Host does not implement.
states.source_classifier: PeripheralEvent admission returns InputAck(accepted=false, rejection_reason=unsupported_peripheral_kind) and never reaches native injection
states.ui_surface: Input feedback and protocol diagnostics for the active session
states.user_visible_copy: Unsupported peripheral kind, keep the session active, and use a supported touch, keyboard, pointer, stylus, or controller path
states.user_action: Switch to a supported input device or update both peers after a concrete peripheral kind is implemented and accepted.

states.system_state: File transfer is denied by managed policy, maximum-file policy, invalid file metadata, user denial, or a fail-closed transfer admission check.
states.source_classifier: FileTransferSession, FileTransferProductOwner, FileAccept, FileTransferCancel, and FileTransferComplete policy_denied or bounded rejection reasons
states.ui_surface: File transfer sheet, transfer-result feedback, and protocol diagnostics
states.user_visible_copy: File transfer denied by policy or file limits with the specific rejection reason surfaced through the file-transfer UI
states.user_action: Choose a permitted file, reduce file size if the limit was exceeded, or ask the administrator to allow file transfer before retrying.

states.system_state: Clipboard forwarding is denied because clipboard capability is not negotiated, managed policy disables clipboard, MIME or byte limits fail, or explicit approval is absent.
states.source_classifier: Clipboard offer/request/content admission, managed ClipboardAllowed status, maximumClipboardBytes, MIME, SHA-256, origin, and approval state checks
states.ui_surface: Clipboard action feedback and protocol diagnostics for explicit send/get/overwrite actions
states.user_visible_copy: Clipboard sharing denied by policy, unsupported content, missing capability, or size limit with no silent pasteboard mutation
states.user_action: Enable clipboard capability and managed policy, use text/plain within the negotiated byte limit, approve the explicit transfer, then retry.

states.system_state: Mac Host intentionally ends the current session.
states.source_classifier: SessionFailureKind.SERVER_SHUTDOWN
states.ui_surface: Mode-specific terminal guidance surface
states.user_visible_copy: connection_guidance_session_ended_title and connection_guidance_mac_ended_session_message
states.user_action: Leave the app disconnected or start a new session from the Mac and reconnect.

states.system_state: Android user taps Disconnect or otherwise intentionally ends the session.
states.source_classifier: SessionFailureKind.USER_REQUESTED
states.ui_surface: Disconnected state guidance
states.user_visible_copy: connection_guidance_session_ended_title and connection_guidance_user_disconnected_message
states.user_action: Use Try Again or the relevant pairing flow when the user wants to reconnect.

states.system_state: Host cannot capture because Screen Recording permission is missing or stale after a rebuild.
states.source_classifier: DisplaySettings.hasScreenRecordingPermission and capture startup guard
states.ui_surface: Host onboarding view and startup alert
states.user_visible_copy: Allow Screen & System Audio Recording / Screen Recording and relaunch Vibe Screen
states.user_action: Grant the installed Vibe Screen app Screen Recording in System Settings, quit, reopen, and rerun the Host preflight.

contract.title: Screen Recording permission denied
contract.body: The macOS Host cannot capture a display because Screen Recording permission is missing or stale for the installed app identity.
contract.action: Grant Screen Recording to the installed Vibe Screen app in System Settings, quit, reopen, and rerun the Host preflight.

states.system_state: Touch, keyboard, native pointer, or window migration is requested without Accessibility permission.
states.source_classifier: AXIsProcessTrusted guard and WindowRecoveryError.accessibilityPermissionRequired
states.ui_surface: Host onboarding/settings copy and runtime logs
states.user_visible_copy: Enable input and window control; Accessibility lets tablet gestures control the Mac and lets Vibe Screen move and restore windows.
states.user_action: Grant Accessibility to the stable signed installed app, quit and reopen Vibe Screen, then retry input or window movement.

contract.title: Accessibility permission denied
contract.body: macOS input injection or window movement is unavailable because Accessibility is not granted to the stable signed Host app.
contract.action: Grant Accessibility to the stable signed installed app, quit and reopen Vibe Screen, then retry input or window movement.

states.system_state: USB setup cannot find adb, finds no authorized Android device, or finds multiple devices without a selected target.
states.source_classifier: Host ADB setup and device selection diagnostics
states.ui_surface: Host status/settings diagnostics and Android USB guidance
states.user_visible_copy: Install Android Platform Tools, connect and authorize exactly one device, or select the intended endpoint before repairing the USB route.
states.user_action: Authorize the phone, select the intended device in the Mac app, use the USB repair action, then retry.

states.system_state: TCP port 54321 is not available to clients because the Host listener is not running, cannot bind, or is already bound by another process or previous Host instance.
states.source_classifier: NWListener startup/listening state, listener readiness preflight, and SingleInstanceProcessLockError.alreadyRunning
states.ui_surface: Host startup alert and troubleshooting runbook
states.user_visible_copy: Start Vibe Screen on the Mac, or quit the conflicting process that owns TCP 54321 before retrying.
states.user_action: Start or restart Vibe Screen on the Mac. If lsof -nP -iTCP:54321 -sTCP:LISTEN shows another listener, stop it and restart Vibe Screen.

contract.title: TCP 54321 unavailable
contract.body: The Host is not reachable on TCP port 54321 because the listener is absent, failed to start, or the port is occupied.
contract.action: Start or restart Vibe Screen on the Mac. If another process is listening on TCP 54321, stop it and restart Vibe Screen.

states.system_state: ScreenCaptureKit exposes no capturable display, capture stops, or the Mac is headless without a usable physical, dummy, or Screen Sharing display.
states.source_classifier: ScreenCapture setup and terminal capture failure handling
states.ui_surface: Host capture failure alert and runbook
states.user_visible_copy: Unlock the Mac, attach a physical or dummy display, or switch to Current Main Display after granting Screen Recording.
states.user_action: Recheck Screen Recording, attach or select a usable display, relaunch after permission changes, and retry streaming.

states.system_state: Private CGVirtualDisplay APIs are absent, denied, or no longer behave after a macOS update.
states.source_classifier: VirtualDisplayManager availability and creation errors
states.ui_surface: Host display-source fallback guidance
states.user_visible_copy: Use Current Mac Display or attach a physical/dummy display when the private virtual-display path is unavailable.
states.user_action: Switch display source to Current Main Display, attach a dummy/physical display if needed, then rerun the relevant display acceptance gate.

states.system_state: A client-selected physical or virtual display is unavailable by the time the Host applies the request.
states.source_classifier: DisplayCatalog.resolve and handleClientDisplaySelection
states.ui_surface: Host logs and Android display-selection pending/rejected UI in PR #272
states.user_visible_copy: Keep the current stream active, reject the stale display selection, and keep the user on the last confirmed display.
states.user_action: Refresh the display list, select an online display, or switch the Host to Current Main Display.

states.system_state: LAN mode has no usable trusted-network address, firewall allowance, or current QR pairing route.
states.source_classifier: WirelessAuth token/admission diagnostics and trusted-LAN runbook
states.ui_surface: Host LAN settings and Android wireless repair surface
states.user_visible_copy: Use a trusted private Wi-Fi, verify the Mac address and port, allow Vibe Screen through the firewall, and scan a fresh QR if the token changed.
states.user_action: Reconnect both devices to the same trusted Wi-Fi, confirm firewall and address, then pair or reconnect again.

states.system_state: Login startup is requested but the macOS login item or onboarding preconditions are not approved.
states.source_classifier: HostStartupPolicy and AutomaticLaunchCoordinator
states.ui_surface: Host settings and login/headless runbook
states.user_visible_copy: Approve the login item only after onboarding is complete and permissions are stable.
states.user_action: Complete onboarding with a monitor attached, approve the Login Item, log out and back in, then verify the Host listener and Android reconnect evidence.

states.system_state: Internet profile is revoked, expired, rejected, or cannot recover its route.
states.source_classifier: InternetConnectionStatus.revoked/failed and Phase 3 product-session callbacks
states.ui_surface: Host Internet settings and Android Internet error surface
states.user_visible_copy: Revoke stale credentials, create or import a fresh session profile, and retry the selected Direct or TURN route.
states.user_action: Use a fresh Host-issued profile and keep failed/revoked Internet states below release status until public-network evidence exists.
